name: premium-ux
description: Build apps that feel premium and audit shipped products for what makes them feel cheap. Covers state coverage, cross-screen coherence, failure and recovery design, flow psychology (smart defaults, endowed progress, reciprocity, ownership, loss framing, anchoring), motivation design (completion drive, winnable competition, competence feedback) and the dark-pattern line. Includes a scored audit rubric, a report template, and a state-coverage scanner.
